newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Buying of high-caps lifts Romanian OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Buying of high-caps lifts Romanian OTC market.

text.p: Blue chips on Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed higher on Friday on buying pressure which had permeated trading throughout the week, operators said.
They said the upward trend would continue early next week due to strong foreign investor interest, but warned that corrections might appear soon.
"Blue chips will continue to gain in the first few days of next week, but they will soon grow too expensive and will head for a correction," one trader said.
He said oil refineries and cement makers would remain in focus, but investors would also show interest in smaller capitalisation companies.
On Friday, gainers led decliners 164 to 88, with 259 stocks remaining flat.
Three independent indices computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation climbed from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index was up 3.4 percent to 6,048.8 points, BIG-OTC rose by 3.65 percent to 4,758.58 and CAS-RQ grew 3.41 percent to 1,073 points.
Arpechim went up 2,000 lei to 53,000, Petrobrazi rose 1,000 lei to close at 53,000 and Petromidia was 2,000 lei firmer at 40,500.
Cement maker Romcim closed 13,000 lei higher at 135,000 in high late-trading demand. Steel mill Sidex inched up 1,500 lei to 24,000.
Turnover on Friday rose to 40.2 billion lei from 28.17 billion previously.
